query: What happens when Samsung Galaxy S9 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: DO NOT BUY. Phone is advertised as "unlocked". Phone would not activate with Straight Talk using Verizon Towers. Straight talk stated they were unsure what the problem was unless it was still locked. Contacted the seller (Infitek) who took several days to respond with a code to unlock the phone. Phone never gave the option to enter the code. Purchased a new sim card and the phone will would not activate with carrier. Return the phone buy only option given UPS pickup with a message stating refund would be given within 7 days of receiving the item. Day 7 still no refund, contacted amazon who states it may take additional time. Will never purchase from this seller again.

Blown speaker. I bought a renewed s9 from here for $175 and its in excellent condition for sure but when I activated it to use i had learned that the speaker is blown. That was NOT put into the product description. I feel that it should have been tested better and listed as blown speaker for the potential buyer.

Awesome, reputable seller! Great cust svc and products. Seller Wireless Cloud is exceptional! A lot of trust in your seller is necessary when purchasing a refurb, and he has proven to be extremely trustworthy and focused on customer satisfaction! The 1st refurbished Galaxy S9 I received from him was in perfect cosmetic condition and great working order with all applications, as described... except it had a problem reading the SIM and kept dropping me from the network... tried several carriers over 2 months with same results and found out it was a very rare manufacture flaw that would easily go undetected during the refurb process. By the time this was discovered, my window of return had officially expired. Fortunately, Mo was very responsive when I alerted him to this mysterious issue, supportive through the whole process, and happy to exchange it for me when it couldn't be fixed.
Horrible seller. Phone is locked and linked to someone else account

Phone is Defective!!! Scam!!!. We received the phone just with a charger and its cable - nothing else! Then when we tried to charge the phone, it was not charging! Instead it kept vibrating non-stop without any indications on the screen! We thought that the phone would explode! To top it off, upon return it, we had to pay for its shipment! For a mistake the seller made! THIS IS A SCAM! I don't recommend this Galaxy S9 from this seller! Amazon should at least put a DISCLAIMER, if returning item, the customer will pay!
I want my pnoe or my money baack....pure and simple. I received the S9 box unsealed and without the phone... i was stune... I'm an amazon buyer since 2007, My 1st incident ever

The seller is fairly quick to respond to inquiries. If you're someone who's on the fence about this purchase, I can tell you that this is a reliable seller. I got what I paid for quickly with no hassle. I'm very happy with my purchase.
Buyers Beware!. The phone I purchased in 2019 is a factory unlocked T-mobile not an international version phone which relocked after a couple years.
It was NOT new as described!!!. It was new as described. There was t mobile SIM card inserted inside the phone. We are displeased that the seller was not honest about the product.

Samsung Galaxy version international does not have warranty!!!!. After 4 months of use, the telephone started to loose touch screen sensibility. I have read all the blogs and support pages and it simply does not work correctly. the touchscreen sometimes does not recognize when I write. I have contacted Samsung and they told me that that they can only support phones who are not "international versions". So, the call center recommend me to repair by myself the device because there is not warranty for this kind of devices. So, please take in consideration before you buy a new device in amazon that there is not warranty if it is a international version.

Don’t buy!. It is the worst phone I’ve ever seen. The incoming call's voice sounds is really low and can’t hear what the person is saying. The seller is not cooperating well. They used to make confused the customers even if you provide all information as they needed.

NO MORE SAMSUNG FOR ME!. This is my 4th Galaxy phone and my last. One month into owning the S9 the dreaded and well-documented 'flickering green screen' starting happening. None of the online quick fixes worked for me except for keeping the brightness level at 10% or 90%+. Fortunately, the phone is under a 60 day return policy so back it goes. This is a known software issue that Samsung won't acknowledge. There are new phones like the One Plus Nord N200 that cost the same and have the latest OS and updates. That's where I'm headed. Beware. No more Samsung for me!

Screen Burn. Phone came with a few scratches, which I expected. However, upon closer look the screen had images burned into it. It looked like this phone was a display phone and the images got burned into the screen. I was really upset and am returning sad they're also making me pay postage to return the damaged phone ?
damaged phone sold as new. just tried to use this phone. it will not charge. appears damaged. thanks alot.

Phone picture is not to clear do to double screen. The fingerprint area is scratched & makes it hard to read my print. There is also a screen behind the actual screen I'm looking at. I notified the seller, but have not heard anyback yet.

Good phone, good seller. I bought it for a friend. She said the battery dies kind of quick but everything works great and it arrived quickly. I’m an iPhone person so I don’t like it but she seems happy with it. It came at a good price and the seller shipped quickly and safely.

Defective phone. It got to my address on a timely manner but when i tried to switch it to straighttalk i keep getting internal error 407 straighttalk told me i had a defective phone so seriously just buy the phone from your provider instead of here.

Awesome Device and Happy w/ Seller. So I bought from Bcfly4 and this review is for them as much as it is for the S9. The S9 is a great phone. Replacing the screen is about 280-300 bucks though so it's about the same to just buy a refurb and start over. Also the international S9 can run Lineage OS and /e/ OS so super excited. Thanks

Virgin mobile Samsung s9. Really liked how it was slim and fit into my hand. It was very easy to merge apps from old phone. The one BIG issue I have is when you make and receive calls you can barely hear the other person unless you put it on speaker. I contacted seller to see if its just my phone or a ongoing issue

Buyer Beware! Itsthe China-version its not the G960F (International). I love Samsung Galaxies but twice I received the model made for China and not the US/Europe "International version. Do not buy from Quick Ship Express. At this point I think I have to give up and look elsewhere to buy the right version I want.
